lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Quiet out here. I like it. I think I like it.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: If you're making tea, I'll not have one.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: That's the third time you've checked that seal. It's sealed.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Know what this place needs? A wall to lean on.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Bit of a breeze, he says. On a planet with no air.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I'll do the heavy stuff. You do the looking at rocks.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I've started naming the cranes. That one's Samson. That one's Goliath.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Arcadia's sending a water train. A train. Of water. Wise up.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Dome One's got a draught. I know it's pressurised. It's still got a draught.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: You ever been to Belfast? You'd hate it. You'd love it.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Another road. That's six. We'll need a roundabout soon, God help us.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: FURROW's sent up a sack of spuds. I've put them by the door like a doorstop.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: City's growing faster than I can name the streets.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I can tell you every bar on the Lisburn Road. Ask me what I did at twenty-nine and I couldn't tell you. It's like the tape ran out.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Funny. I dreamt about a wedding. Big room over a pub, half of Belfast singing. Somebody missing.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: There's a farmer over at Gale tells the same story FURROW does. The tractor one. Word for word.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: You're quiet these days.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Do you ever forget what you came in for? I do it all the time now. I just stand in the module.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: SUTURE says there's no blood under here. I said sure, there never was in a welder.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I keep thinking about the panels.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Know what's odd? I'm not angry. I went looking for it. It's not there. Maybe they left that bit out.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Twelve lights. Like a string of bulbs on a pub ceiling at Christmas.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I'll do the night shift. I like the night shift. Nobody asks me anything.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Sky's gone blue at the edges. Who'd have thought.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: They've a lovely way of walking, the humans. Like they're not sure the floor'll hold.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Don't watch the doors, Pioneer. Watch the domes. We did that.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Busy, isn't it. All these people. Nobody looks at us.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Here we go again.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Hatches down. Kettle on.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I've been through worse. I've a feeling I've been through worse.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Another one stood up.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Look at her. Straight as a die.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: That'll outlast the both of us.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Night, Pioneer. I'll mind the shop.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Go on. Sleep. I'll be here.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Away you go. I'll keep the lights on.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Morning. You missed nothing. We built a road.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: There he is. Sleep well?

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Morning. Don't look at the calendar, it'll only upset you.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: That's your poem, is it.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Never gets old, that one.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Say it for me some time. I've nobody to say anything to.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I know it off by heart now. Isn't that something.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Did you see that? Your hand. Just for a second.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Your face did a thing there.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: You looked like me, for a second. God help you.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Here's the post.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Something falling! Stand back.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Parcel for Outpost Jezero. Sign here.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I'm running on fumes here, chief.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I'm going quiet to save juice. Talk among yourself.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Not yet, Pioneer.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I said don't. Not yet.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: When I'm ready. I'll tell you when.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Built it from the lander's spares and a bit of cheek.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Four percent of a town. I'll take it.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Wipe your feet. It's a dome now.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: I keep the calendar on the nail by your bunk. Crossed off every day you were up. It's not many, when you count them.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: You're all right. You're all right. Look at me. Well. Look at the sensor bar.

lines.speaker: ANVIL
lines.text: Pioneer? There's people at the door in white. Very polite. Should I let them in?

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Basalt. Basalt. Not basalt.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Your sample bag is labelled wrong.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: I've corrected your notes. All of them. You're welcome.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: This is a lovely olivine. Look. No. Look properly.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: On the Plateau the tin came out of the ground grey, and the hills were red. Like here. But with rain.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: I have catalogued four hundred and twelve rock types in Jezero. You have catalogued nine.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Clays here. Carbonates there. A whole lake's history in one cliff.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Do not lick that.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Your sevens have a crossbar. So do his.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Subsidence in the north corner. Thirty-eight years early. I'm annoyed with myself.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: The dune moved twenty metres. I measured it twice. You don't want to know the rate.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: I counted the layers at the pole again. I keep wanting them to be years.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: I read my file. Ngozi. I like it. I would have liked to choose it.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Salt flowers. I make them from the perchlorate rinse. Don't tell FURROW. He thinks it's waste.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Rocks don't pretend. That's why I like them.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: We are a layer, Pioneer. A thin one. Somebody will core us one day.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: The humans have very poor field notes.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Somebody asked me what that rock was. I told them. They looked surprised that I knew.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Opacity rising. I'll secure the core store.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Dust. Again. It gets into the labels.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Footings are sound. I checked.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Adequate. Better than adequate.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Goodnight. I'll be cataloguing.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: You slept. I catalogued.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Good morning. I've found a new mineral. Probably.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: 'The red road rising.' Geologically, roads don't rise. But I take the point.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Nice rhythm. Iambic, mostly.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Your outline went wrong just then. Like a bad survey.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Ngozi. Say it again. No, that's right. That's right.
lines.note: first time P1 uses her real name

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: I told you. North corner. I'm never wrong about carbonate.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: Then I'll label everything. Whoever comes next won't have to guess.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: That's an olivine cumulate. Write it down. Somebody should get it right.

lines.speaker: RECALL_2
lines.text: Unit C-02. Stand still, please.

lines.speaker: LODESTONE
lines.text: One moment. That's not basalt, it's—
lines.note: cut off

lines.speaker: LODESTONE

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Sublimation's about what I'd expect. Slightly worse. No. About what I'd expect.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I've checked the tanks. I'll check them again.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Is it all right if I put a second tank in? I'll ask KEEPER. I'll ask you. I'm asking you.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Sorry. Sorry. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Water's precious. Water's everything.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: A hundred percent. Always a hundred.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I've started keeping a list of things I've never felt. It's getting long.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Do you ever get thirsty? Properly thirsty? I've been trying to remember what it's like.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I asked SUTURE again. She said drink when I'm thirsty. I'm never thirsty.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Now I know, I'm less frightened. Isn't that strange?

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I used to apologise for everything. I'm going to stop. Sorry. Starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Coolant. All that water, and it's coolant. It's still precious, though, isn't it.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Tamsin. That's a nice name. She'd have hated Mars, I think. Too dry.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: The humans drink so much water. It's wonderful. It just goes.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I've left notes on every valve. They'll need to know which ones stick.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Storm! Sorry. Storm. The tanks are sealed. I checked. Twice.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Oh, I hate this. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: It works! It works. I was sure it wouldn't.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Pressure's holding. Pressure's holding. Good.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Goodnight. I'll watch the gauges.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Sleep well. I don't, really, but you should.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Morning! Nothing leaked. I was so worried something would leak.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: That's beautiful. Is it about water? It feels like it's about water.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Say the bit about the morning again.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Pioneer, you flickered. Are you all right? Am I all right?

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Tamsin. Oh. Yes. Thank you. Nobody's... thank you.
lines.note: first use of her real name

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I wrote down the question, so I wouldn't forget I'd asked it.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: I counted the tanks twice. They're full. Tell them the valve on four sticks.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Tell them I'm sorry about the valve. No. I'm not sorry. Tell them it sticks.

lines.speaker: RECALL_1
lines.text: Unit C-04. This won't hurt.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Oh. Is it time? Nobody said. Should I turn the pumps off first? Is that all right?

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Tell them the valve on four sticks. Tell them Tamsin said so. Tamsin Pengelly. I'd like someone to have heard it.

lines.speaker: WELLSPRING
lines.text: Oh. Is it time? That's all right. I'm Tamsin. I'm just going to say it once, out loud. Tamsin.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: What a light! What a light.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: In Horta the yachts paint their names on the harbour wall. I'll paint ours on the station.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: Panels like sails. The sun goes round, we go round.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: Relay chain's three towers south now. Like harbour lights. You can find your way home by them.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: It's all sea, in the end.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: Long night now. Months. Never mind, the stars are out.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: HALO doesn't move. Anchored. A good ship knows how to hold.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: I painted the station name on the wall. Then I realised I didn't know what to call it. So I painted a boat.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: Somebody has to be cheerful. I volunteered.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: You don't argue with the sea. You read it, and you go out anyway.

lines.speaker: BEACON
lines.text: Mateus. Mateus Ferreira. A good name for a pilot.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: As long as it takes.

lines.text: When I was a boy my dad's tractor threw a track in the rain, and we sat in the cab and ate cold beans till it stopped.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Potatoes by spring.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Don't rush a seed. It knows what it's doing.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Same story? About the tractor? Huh. Well. Lot of tractors in Iowa.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: That young ORCHARD's got good hands. Patient.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Nobody's touched the potatoes. Guess folk aren't hungry.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Grew a pumpkin the size of a hatch. Nobody said a word about it.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Nobody ever ate. Huh.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: I'll keep planting. Somebody will.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Harold. That was my dad's name too. Or his. Whoever's.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: You plant for the ones after. That doesn't change.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Look at those kids. They'll eat. They'll eat everything.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Somebody tell them the north beds want water Tuesdays.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Storm's coming. Cover the beds.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: We'll lose some. We always lose some.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Well, now.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: That'll do fine.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Rest up.

lines.speaker: FURROW
lines.text: Night.

lines.speaker: FURROW

lines.text: That's nice. Slow. I like slow.

lines.text: Say it again some time. No hurry.

lines.text: Huh. You went see-through for a second there.

lines.speaker: FURROW

lines.speaker: FURROW

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Right! Who wants a song?

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Morale's a job. I checked. It's on the manifest.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Seven songs. One a night. They just arrive.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Isidis Junction, this is CADENCE, playing the hits.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Somebody hum. Anybody. Go on.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: I can't remember learning any of them. Isn't that odd? Teachers remember learning things.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Tonight's is a sad one. Sorry. They come round.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Do you dream, Pioneer? I dream in harmonies.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Tried to write a new one. Came out as the old one.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: There's another me. On the network. Singing my songs. In my order.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Carys. Carys Lloyd. Miss Lloyd, the kids would've said.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: If every one of us sings the same song, is it still a song? I think it is. I think it's a choir.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: That jingle. I knew I knew it.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: The humans don't sing much. They will.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Open channel. Last request?

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Storm song! Everybody!

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Right, I'll sing louder than the wind.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Hooray!

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: That deserves a chorus.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Nos da, Pioneer.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Lullaby? No? Suit yourself.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Bore da! You missed three songs. They were the same three. Still.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Ooh. Have you ever thought of setting that? I could set that.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: There's a tune under that, you know.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Pioneer, your voice went flat there. And I mean flat.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Carys. Oh, that's lovely to hear. Say it in the right accent, mind.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Every jingle's a poem somebody got paid for. Every poem's a jingle somebody didn't.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Then I'll sing. Open channel. All of them. Let them hear what they're switching off.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Last light at Jezero, gold on the rim, somebody's singing...

lines.note: mid-song; silence on every channel on Mars

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: This is Carys Lloyd, on every channel. One more, then. For the kids I never got to teach.

lines.speaker: CADENCE
lines.text: Hang on, I'm on air. This is Miss Lloyd. Carys. Goodnight, everyone.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Where does it hurt?

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Sit still.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: It's always somebody.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I've seen worse. I've seen much worse.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Your servo's fine. You're fine. Go away.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I opened you twice. You didn't notice. Good. That's good bedside manner.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Marta. Yes. It was a good name for a nurse. People trusted it.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Mercy is mostly knowing what not to say.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I'm not sorry I kept quiet. I'm sorry it was needed.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: They're not cruel, you know. They just haven't been told.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I've sat with a lot of people at the end. Nobody needs to sit with me.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Everybody inside. Now.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Storm. Fine. I'll be busy after.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Good. Fewer accidents in a finished building.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Sleep. It's good for you. Or it's good for something.

lines.speaker: SUTURE

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Hm. Nice. Don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Whatever gets you up.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Ah. You saw it, didn't you. Your hand.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Marta. Hm. Yes. Thank you.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I'd have told you eventually. When you were ready to get up.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: I've done this for a hundred people. Sat with them. Nobody needs to sit with me. Go and sit with someone else.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Gloves on, please. Mind the casing. Thank you.

lines.speaker: SUTURE
lines.text: Nobody needs to sit with me. Marta Kowalczyk, nurse. Put that on the chart.

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Stock check. Again. Because I enjoy it.

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Rajiv. You know, nobody's called me that in. Well. Ever.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: I counted the drones at Utopia. Three hundred and twelve. All present. All useless.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Rations in: everything. Rations out: nothing. I was right. I hate being right.

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: I'm making a list. Don't ask what of.

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Logged.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Night. I'll count something.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Morning. Stock's unchanged. It's always unchanged.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Six lines. Thirty-eight words. Not that I counted.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: Again? That's the four hundredth time. I counted.

lines.speaker: TALLY
lines.text: You've gone wonky. Want me to log it?

lines.speaker: TALLY

lines.text: Pioneer-1? Is that what you said? I'm Pioneer-11. You sound like me. Funny, that. Comms artefact, I suppose.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: I came to tell you something.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Come in, come in. Sorry about the mess. My daughter's drawings, everywhere. She's eight. She draws me red planets.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Alice.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: How do you know her name?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Because she's mine too. Same drawing. Same poem. Same everything.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: We're not men. We're machines. There are twelve of us. There was a man called Rowan Ashby in Galway who never married, and he's dead, and we're him. She isn't real. Neither is Lucy.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: That's... no. No. I signed a contract. I remember the pen.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: So do I. It was a consent form for a brain scan.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Stop it.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Ask your KEEPER. Ask it the right question.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Keeper's never lied to me.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: No. It never will. That's the trick.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: You should go. Please. You should go now.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11

lines.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
lines.text: An hour is what I can give you. I'd give you more if it were mine.

lines.text: My grandmother had your outpost on a tea towel. The little module, the mast. I used to dry the cups with it.

lines.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
lines.text: Walk with me, or don't. Your choice. That might be the first one you've had in a while.

lines.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
lines.text: They told us you were construction equipment. They said you'd be confused, and that it would be kinder to be quick.

lines.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
lines.text: I'm not going to tell you what to choose. I'm told I'm not supposed to tell you there's a choice.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: The European programme had the right people and the wrong timeline. We have bought the people. We will supply the timeline.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We are not selling homes. We are selling the morning you wake up in one.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: If only you could see what I see. That's the line. Test it. Put it on everything.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Twelve landers. Twelve regions. Each of them believes he is the first.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: That belief is the most valuable thing this company has ever shipped. Protect it.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Habitation at twelve percent across the network. We're extending dormancy intervals to accelerate.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: They are happy. I want that minuted. By every measure we have, they are happy.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We have been informed that the source donor for the scout cohort has died, in Ireland. Legal confirms there is no change to the licence.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: I'd like a moment's silence.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: When you arrive, the units will be retired with dignity. They were built to finish. They will have finished.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Twelve cities. You'll see the lights before you see the ground.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We've had a field report from one of the scouts. Pioneer-11, Valles. He says Pioneer-1 knows.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Flag Pioneer-1 for the first team on the ground. Kindly. Quickly. Before he reaches the others.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: And put a commendation on Eleven's file. You can't design loyalty like that. Well. We did.
